proofIssues.originalScope:
Create the bounded compatibility repair within #141 under program #107. The journal-only producer and normal-only source approval reader mismatch is proven at source commit 81e1d58264485883d6bdda4d77a6906b9a4b84d9. An absent primary admission root in a dry run is intentional first-use refusal, not proof of damaged authority. Do not reopen or repair closed #102 by assumption.

This epic owns coordination and acceptance of exactly seven bounded children:

- A: Adopt the bounded journal approval contract — 1 human hour(s).
- B: Verify completed private journals read-only — 3 human hour(s).
- C: Publish immutable portable approval evidence — 2 human hour(s).
- D: Accept versioned registration approval proofs — 2 human hour(s).
- E: Accept versioned finite-class approval proofs — 2 human hour(s).
- F: Make the capture workflow POSIX-only and exact-ref bound — 2 human hour(s).
- G: Prove one genuine current Linux approval end-to-end — 3 human hour(s).

The seven child estimates total 15 HUMAN hours. This epic's original Refine estimate was 1 HUMAN hour for coordination only. Its current governed Plan estimate is 2.5 HUMAN hours for coordination and acceptance only (forecast 01M56P51VTVJTHWV90KRBQCSV3); it is not the implementation estimate for all seven children. All eight individual estimates are at most four human hours. A+B form the first four-human-hour decision checkpoint; lack of reproducible valid/negative proof there returns the approach to planning rather than silently expanding it. No implementation is authorized by this issue creation.

The actual finite-class guarantee and remaining installed Linux/macOS recovery remain #141-owned. This epic ends with one genuine current Linux absence-class approval; broader class matrix/installed recovery and #107 activation/release remain outside its completion claim. Preserve the legacy normal checker, every capture signature/pre-registration/producer-freeze/current-scope check, and historical proof compatibility. New approved-ref formats must be explicit/versioned, never a mode/status relabel.

### Owner limits and preservation

The owner subsequently authorized driving all seven children of #214 to Done through the governed workflow. Implementation, required independent reviews, verification and applicable child delivery/approval/Close gates are authorized within the existing bounded scopes. The four-hour cumulative agent-engagement limit per child remains mandatory. This does not authorize #107 public activation or any operation on the protected unsettled review/session. Preserve every platform, assurance and historical timing constraint below.

Estimates are HUMAN effort hours, including routine review/verification; they are not agent-time estimates. Agent engagement has a separate hard failure rule: if this story engages agents cumulatively for MORE THAN FOUR HOURS, its current plan is FAILED and SCRAPPED. Stop implementation, preserve all work and evidence, and return to planning to determine a better course. Do not continue because the work is nearly finished or extend the limit. Stop at the four-hour boundary before knowingly exceeding it. Count all engaged investigation, implementation, debugging, review and verification for this story across agents, sessions and restarts; reassignment, timer switching or a new session must not reset or evade the limit. Correctly attributed child work is counted against that child; epic coordination has its own limit. Pause passive external waits honestly. Preserve Unknown timing values as Unknown; never assume unknown history is zero, invent accounting, or claim unused engagement allowance without evidence. If remaining allowance cannot be established, stop for a planning decision. Scrapping a plan never authorizes deletion of code, Git history, reviews, worktrees or evidence.

Linux and macOS are the only supported runtime targets. Windows #213 remains indefinitely deferred, unscheduled and nonblocking; no Windows worker or native build is authorized. Preserve historical Windows evidence. Future Windows activation requires fresh then-current requirements and analysis.

Preserve review-2bdf5dd8ee56accc6e494643054a3cf1 and Claude session 1c82a9bc-d4dd-4d10-92b5-022615f0abcd unchanged and unsettled. Do not replay, terminate, reconcile, convert or infer acceptance from either. Preserve every historical timing row and all Unknown values; no accounting repair.

Retain budgets 30000/15000/5000/800000 ms and portable cap four. Keep ordinary local handoffs free of primary enrollment/source-class prerequisites. No old runtime fallback, mode/status relabeling, blanket scanner rewrite, weaker capture validation or public activation follows from this work.

Execution-order correction discovered during governed intake: F -> A -> B -> C -> D -> E -> G. The newly created branches otherwise inherit all-platform CI defaults. F must first deliver the exact-ref Linux/macOS routing, including its own branch before its first push. This is the same bounded F story and estimate, not an extra story. A+B remain the first proof-design/verifier decision checkpoint after the platform bootstrap. G depends on both E and F. All executable producer changes must finish before real capture.
